violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED STEAK AT 49-50F, TERIYAKI CHICKEN AT 47F, SLICED TURKEY AT 47F, SLICED CHEESE AT 49-51F, SALAMI AT 51F, AND PROVOLONE AT 51-53F IN THE LEFT SERVICE LINE; OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 44-45F IN THE RIGHT SERVICE LINE; OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 44-45F IN THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED TCS FOODS TO THE WALK-IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE LEFT SERVICE LINE AT 47F, RIGHT SERVICE LINE AT 45F, AND THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 57F WITH THE EHS THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED TCS FOODS TO THE WALK-IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION. THE OWNER CALLED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THESE COOLERS ARE REPAIRED WITHIN 24 HOURS AND PROOF THE COOLERS ARE WORKING PROPERLY IS PROVIDED TO THE EHS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION AND THAT A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.
